page.layout: Two printed columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, left and right, separated by a vertical rule. Running heads "ת ח" above each column, page number 433 at top right. Gathering signature "Iii" and catchword "fut." at the foot of the right column.

main_text.p: תָּחְסֶה sperabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel, 3. f. f. Rad. חָסָה.
תַּחְסֹם obturabis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. חָסַם.
וַתֵּחָן[?] & dividetnr, Dan. 11. 4. (pro תַּחְצָה,) fut. Niph. 3. f. f. apoc. Rad. חָצָה.
תַּחְרָא lorica, No. f. m. R. תחר.
תַּחְרִים devovebis, vel bit, תַּחְרִימֵם eos, devovebitis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. & 2. pl. m. Rad. חָרַם.
תַּחְרֵשׁ araberis, vel tur, תַּחְשֵׁב reputaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָרַשׁ, & חָשַׁב.
תַּחְשְׁבֵנִי reputant me, Job. 19. 15. Vide in Clavi Hebr. pro תַּחְשׁוּבְנָה אוֹתִי; fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. aff. R. חָשַׁב.
תָּחְשִׁים pelles taxeæ, pl. m. No. Rad. תַּחַשׁ taxus, melis.
תַּחַת descendes, vel det, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. (pro תְּנַחַת,) Rad. נָחַת.
תַּחַת, vel תָּחַת consternator, תַּחְחוּ, vel תָּחֲחוּ consternemini, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. חָתַת.
הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה, תַּחְתּוֹנָה inferior, & plur. מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנוֹת ab inferioribus, No. sing. masc. תַּחְתּוֹן inferior, parag. ut & No. f. & pl. f. præf. à part. Rad. תַּחַת subter.
תַּחְתִּי sub me, יְ loco ejus, יְנוּ pro nobis, qu. in forma f. m. & pl. m. aff. à part. Rad. תַּחַת.
תַּחְתִּי inferior, יָה, יִת, infima, יִם, יוֹת inferiora, No. f. & pl. m. & fæm. à part. Rad. תַּחַת.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation is reproduced from a small, heavily inked scan and may be imperfect. Doubtful forms are marked [?]. The entry "& dividetnr" (printed "dividetnr") and its Hebrew form are uncertain. The entry beginning "obsignavit" continues on the next page. Printing errors such as "dividetnr" and "reputaberis" are left as printed.
